name: bingo-arena-monorepo
description: BINGO ARENA - Enterprise Real-Time Multiplayer Bingo Gaming Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bingo/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bingo/server && npm run build --workspace=@bingo/client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist','build',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});}"
